recentEvents.text: EVENT × 2 of 4 MILITARY Republika Srpska NATO Will Not Wait for Markale Cumulative ICTY evidence and the documented shelling of civilian infrastructure drag the NATO threshold forward by more than a year. Allied Force commanders receive strike authorisations that in the historical record waited until August 1995. The VRS loses the freedom of movement it had relied on through 1994; front-line commanders begin to plan their operations around coverage windows of the no-fly zone rather than around the enemy. The war's endgame window has closed on Republika Srpska earlier than Mladic's staff had projected.
